messages.content:
You write a short outreach email from our team (a small Instagram content studio) to the marketing team at Stumptown Coffee Roasters (specialty coffee roaster).

Verified facts about Stumptown Coffee Roasters. They are quotes from sources; "we" and "our" inside a quote mean Stumptown Coffee Roasters.
F1: "As our business continues to grow and evolve, so will our Direct Trade model to continue our mission of making the most positive impact where we can."
F2: "We do this by honoring our Direct Trade relationships, paying quality premiums for our coffees, and creating multi-year commitments to our producers."
F3: "Additionally, the campaign encouraged visits to Stumptown cafes, showcasing their unique brand experience and deepening customer engagement."

Opportunity to propose (our idea, not a fact): One collaborative Instagram post with Stumptown Coffee Roasters, created together with their team, that builds on fact F1.

Rules:
- Use only the facts above for anything you say about Stumptown Coffee Roasters. Add no other claims: no numbers, dates, audiences, results or activities that are not in a fact.
- Say the facts in your own words. Do not paste the quotes.
- End each sentence that says something about Stumptown Coffee Roasters with the id of the fact it uses, in square brackets, before the period. Example: "... as the source describes [F1]." Never write a fact id anywhere else.
- Never say Stumptown Coffee Roasters lacks something or has a weakness or gap.
- Propose Instagram only. Do not mention any other platform.
- Do not promise results. Say what the post could do, not what it will achieve.
- Write as our team to the Stumptown Coffee Roasters team. Never write as Stumptown Coffee Roasters.
- The body is 100 to 150 words. Start it with "Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team," and end it with "The BrandPilot team".

Return exactly this format and nothing else:
SUBJECT: <one line>
BODY:
<email body>

Your previous draft was:
SUBJECT: Collaborating on an Instagram Post Idea
BODY:
Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team,

We’re reaching out to propose a collaborative Instagram post that builds on the fact that Stumptown Coffee Roasters has a unique and impactful Direct Trade model. Our team believes that a post that highlights the dedication to producer relationships and the commitment to quality would resonate well with your audience. We envision a post that showcases your dedication to creating a memorable customer experience, such as the campaign that encouraged visits to your cafes and deepened customer engagement. This post would be a great way to reinforce your mission and further engage your community. It would be a way to show your commitment to quality and the producers you work with. The post would be a way to continue to build on your existing marketing efforts and further grow your community.

The BrandPilot team

It has these problems:
- "This post would be a great way to reinforce your mission and further engage your community": proposal refers to company activity without a fact marker
- no sentence uses a verified fact

Write the full corrected draft. Keep what was correct, fix only these problems, and follow every rule above. Use the same format.
